user.title: Budget Thuis Dynamic Prices
user.description: Add Budget Thuis dynamic electricity price sensors. This reads the public tariff page and requires no account or API key. Only one instance is needed per Home Assistant install.

abort.already_configured: Budget Thuis Dynamic Prices is already set up.

init.title: Contract pricing
init.description: Inkoopvergoeding is your contract's own purchasing fee - match it to the breakdown shown in the Budget Thuis app under your tariff. Energiebelasting isn't asked here: it's a government tax rate, already published per hour on the tariff page, so it's applied automatically. The defaults are a starting point, not guaranteed to match your contract.
